patternCompletion.softRule: Both halves at both delays: completion >= 0.7, with the same >= 0.25 gain requirement.

potentiation.quantileMethod: Linear interpolation at (n-1)*p; empty quantiles are null.

definitions.within: Both endpoints in the named core.
definitions.boundary: Exactly one endpoint in the named core; same boundary as criterion 7.
definitions.betweenCores: Edges between A-only and B-only members, in either direction; shared-core members excluded.

1-stability.rule: Both last-ten-trial mean pairwise Jaccards >= 0.7; strict >= 0.8 reported separately.

2-specificity.rule: Inter-core Jaccard <= 0.2; size is evaluated separately.

4-negative-cue.rule: At both idle durations: nearest-core readback rejects C (< 0.5), C-to-each-core Jaccard <= 0.25, and spillover outside directSet(C) <= 25% of the smaller core.

5-compactness.rule: Observation: each core distance / matched random-subset distance < 0.8; not a Stage 1f gate.

6-recruitment.rule: Observation: at least 30% of each core is outside both trained cues' initial direct sets; not a Stage 1f gate.

7-recurrent-structure.rule: Each core has >= its size surviving growth-formed internal edges, and internal directed density >= 3 times the pool-wide directed density.

8-retention.rule: Locked A probe after 60 seconds has Jaccard >= 0.8 with core A; B also reported.

9-pattern-completion.rule: For A and B, both fixed halves at both delays: completion >= 0.8 and improvement over the untrained circuit on the same core >= 0.25.

10-potentiation.rule: Each core: median surviving within-core formed weight >= 0.6. Ignition fraction is reported, not gated.
